data.body_html:
Imagine gliding out of Puerto Banús as the sun dips behind La Concha, the Mediterranean turning gold, and a gourmet dinner served on deck under a canopy of stars. A Puerto Banús dinner cruise yacht charter combines the luxury of a private yacht with fine dining at sea — an experience that defines Marbella's glamorous coastal lifestyle. Whether you're celebrating an anniversary, proposing, or simply treating friends to an unforgettable evening, our fleet of 17 yachts offers the perfect setting. From the intimate Dubhe (8m, 5 guests) to the majestic Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 guests), every charter includes a licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks, so you can focus on the sunset and the menu.

Why Choose a Dinner Cruise in Puerto Banús?

Puerto Banús is more than a marina — it's a stage for life's best moments. A dinner cruise lets you escape the crowded beach clubs and restaurant terraces, replacing them with your own private floating venue. You control the pace: anchor off Cala del Faro for a quiet swim before dinner, cruise past the Golden Mile mansions, or watch the lights of Estepona twinkle from the water. The combination of sea air, fine food, and the gentle rock of the yacht creates a sensory experience no land-based restaurant can match. With our inclusive pricing — from €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 — it's surprisingly accessible.

Our Yachts for Dinner Cruises

Each yacht in our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and is skippered by a licensed professional. For dinner cruises, we recommend vessels with spacious decks and comfortable saloons. Below is a selection ideal for fine dining at sea:

For a romantic dinner for two, the Dubhe offers intimacy; for a group celebration, the Mangusta 80 provides deck space and a free jet ski. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Dinner catering is arranged separately.

Fine Dining Options at Sea

Your dinner menu can be tailored to your tastes. We work with Marbella's top caterers to deliver a gourmet experience onboard. Typical options include:

  • Seafood feast: grilled prawns, lobster, sea bass, with fresh salads and local wine.
  • Steak dinner: prime cuts with roasted vegetables, truffle mash, and red wine.
  • Vegetarian/vegan: seasonal risottos, grilled vegetables, and plant-based desserts.
  • Tapas menu: jamón ibérico, croquetas, patatas bravas, and Spanish cheeses.

Prices for catering range from €50 to €100 per person, depending on the menu and number of courses. Alternatively, you can bring your own food — the yacht's galley is available for warming or plating. Drinks are already included, but you can upgrade to premium champagne or cocktails at an extra cost.

Best Timing for a Dinner Cruise

The magic hour is sunset. In summer (June–September), sunset occurs around 21:00–21:30, so a 19:00 departure gives you 2 hours of golden light followed by a starlit dinner. In winter, sunset is earlier (18:00–18:30), so a 16:00 start works well. Evening charters can run until 23:00, allowing plenty of time to anchor, dine, and enjoy the night sky. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak season (July–August).

What to Expect on Board

Your skipper will greet you at the berth in Puerto Banús, explain the safety briefing, and then guide you out of the marina. You can choose the itinerary: a slow cruise along the Marbella coast, anchoring in a secluded cove like Cala Cortés, or a longer run to Cabopino or Estepona. The skipper can also recommend the best spots for sunset photos. Onboard, you'll find comfortable seating, a sound system, and often a flybridge for panoramic views. Dinner is served on the aft deck or in the saloon, depending on the weather. After dinner, the skipper will return you to Puerto Banús at your chosen time.

Booking Your Dinner Cruise

Ready to reserve your Puerto Banús dinner cruise yacht charter? Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred yacht, date, number of guests, and any dinner requests. We'll confirm availability and send you a quote. For Tier A yachts (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), pricing starts at €749 for 2 hours. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. Other yachts are priced on request. A 50% deposit secures the booking, with the balance due 48 hours before departure. We accept bank transfer or card payment.
